messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: PyStan 2.0.0.0
parts:
PyStan 2.0.0.0 is up on the Python Package Index

https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan

Changes
-------
- Stan source updated to to 2.0.0.
- PyStan version now mirrors Stan version.
- Rudimentary plot and traceplot methods have been added to fit instances.
- Warmup and sampling progress now visible.

Useful links
------------
- Source code repo: https://github.com/ariddell/pystan
- HTML documentation: http://pystan.readthedocs.org
- Issue tracker: https://github.com/ariddell/pystan/issues

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] PyStan 2.0.0.0
parts:
Cool. Can we wait to announce this more broadly
until we've fixed a couple of issues and released 2.0.1?

I just don't want to frustrate our first large wave
of Python users with a buggy underlying Stan 2.0.0.

I'm going to try to find someone to kick the tires
for you from a users point of view --- I'm totally slammed
myself working on Stan 2.0.1 and a couple of other
projects.

- Bob
